FAQ Cautionary note Thank you very much for your inquiry about our IR. Please take a moment to check the notes, fill in the form below, and click the Confirm button. This form is exclusively for inquiries from our shareholders and investors. For inquiries about products and other matters, please use the contact for inquiries for each . We also request corporations to refrain from using this form for providing information about their products or services or the similar information. Cautionary note Our reply email is intended exclusively for the individual to which it is addressed. Please do not convert all or part of our reply email to a different use or make secondary use of it. Please note that, depending on the content of your inquiry, it may take time or may be impossible to reply. Please also note that we cannot respond to your requests for immediate reply or reply to be given by a specified date.
